method: Resolved durable file references from all debate evidence and included every new evidence file plus ledger and registry. Compared exact Git index bytes with the already audited local files, including previously tracked dependencies. Historical record hashes are checked by the passed full-source and repository auditors, which also authenticate preserved earlier versions. Ignored source/media caches and external session snapshots remain excluded. The reconciliation record itself is added afterward; it contains no new external dependencies.
